Bidder to note that this bid shall be governed by the terms and conditions of the Bidding Docum ent uploaded under Bid Specific Additional Scope of Work. This uploaded instructions/ Terms & Co nditions / Technical specification of the Bidding Document shall supersede the provisions of GeM G TC and any other disclaimers provided in GeM Bid. B. In case a bidder does not register on the GeM Portal and as a consequence, does not submit th e ir bid on GeM Portal, it shall be deemed that he is not interested in bidding against this enquiry a n d no further correspondence will be entertained.. C. Wherever e-tendering portal or NIC or CPP Portal has been mentioned in the commercial section , the same shall be read as GeM Portal. D. Bidder shall quote their Prices on FOT Site basis (i.e., including Freight up to Project Site) includi ng all taxes and duties including GST. However, bidder to mandatorily indicate the rate of GST and Freight percentage included in quoted supply prices in Form-A (Salient Features of Offer) enclosed with RFQ Document uploaded under Bidding Forms. E. Inspection requirement shall be as per relevant clauses of Material Requisition and Bidding Doc ument uploaded under Bid Specific Additional Scope of Work. F. Bidder to furnish all the requisite documents as per Bidding Document uploaded under Specifica tions, failing which their bid may be liable for rejection. Salient Points of the Enquiry Document: 1. CONTRACT PERFORMANCE BANK GUARANTEE (CPBG) Applicable as per Sl No. 22. of Bid Data Sheet (BDS) & Clause No. 7.0 of Specials Purch ase Conditions (SPC). Apart from hard copy submission of bank guarantee (BG), bank g uarantee issued towards CP BG/ABG, etc., it shall be preferred that same is also routed through SFMS (Structured Financial Messaging System) platform for Bank Guarantee is suance and verification. The information/ messaging (as per SFMS platform) shall be se nt by BG issuing bank branch to EILs Banker as per details provided. In case, Supplier d oes not submit CPBG as above, the proportionate amount of CPBG along with interest a ccrued for the period shall be deducted from the invoices raised by Supplier for the res pective milestone payments on pro rata basis, till full recovery. Interest rates to be cha rged on the advances (i.e., differential amount of security deposit etc.) shall be SBI ba se rat e prevailing on the date of enquiry plus 1 percent i.e., 10.90 % (09.90% + 1.00 % ). All bank charges of respective bankers shall be to respective account. 2.PRICE REDUCTION SCHEDULE: ORDERWISE: FROM 0.5% OF TOV TO 5% OF TOV Applicable as per Clause No 10.2 of SPC . NOTE: Total Order Value (TOV) for the purpose of PRS shall mean the Total Order value

as per GeM Contract, but excluding Charges for taxes and duties (i.e. GST @ 18%) and Freight charges. 3.GUARANTEE/WARRANTY Applicable as per Clause No. 6.0 of SPC. 4.PAYMENT TERMs-AS PER BDS 5.PUBLIC PROCUREMENT (PREFERENCE TO MAKE IN INDIA)-NOT APPLICABLE 6.PURCHASE PREFERENCE TO DOMESTICALLY MANUFACTURED ELECTRONIC PROD U CTS (DMEP POLICY)-NOT APPLICABLE 7.DMI&SP (DOMESTICALLY MANUFACTURED IRON & STEEL PRODUCTS) POLICY- NO T APPLICABLE 8.PROCUREMENT FROM BIDDERS FROM A COUNTRY OR COUNTRIES SHARING LAND BORDER WITH INDIA Bidder shall adhere with provisions of Government guidelines regarding procurement from b idders from a country or countries sharing Land Border with India attached as Appendix-X of ITB. 9.INSPECTION Inspection as per the MR/ PR requirement shall be carried out by the TPI Agency, to be appoi nted by supplier, out of the TPIA list mentioned in SPC and charges of the same shall be born e by supplier. Accordingly, bidder shall include the charges of TPI in their quoted price. Refer Clau se no. 11 of SPC .
